name: @sahoda/shared
_sideEffects: The barrel re-exports every module, and without this webpack must assume each one might have a side effect, so NOTHING is tree-shaken: every route that imports one type from @sahoda/shared ships all of it. MEASURED: adding search-tokens.ts put 11 unrelated routes ~8 kB over budget. `*.css` is listed because tokens.css IS a side effect and a blanket false would let webpack drop the stylesheet.
